title: factdiff.py review --judge still defaults to Sonnet 5.5 while census.py judge defaults to Haiku 5.5
goal: factdiff.JUDGE_MODEL names the model census.STEP_MODELS['judge'] names, so factdiff.py review --judge and census.py judge run the same step on the same default model, the tests that pass factdiff.JUDGE_MODEL explicitly still pass, and kb/_self/tools.md's factdiff.py row says which model it defaults to

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import census, factdiff; sys.exit(0 if factdiff.JUDGE_MODEL == census.STEP_MODELS['judge'] else 1)
